point-grey.lede: Point Grey runs from the beaches at Jericho, Locarno and Spanish Banks up to the shops and cafés along West 10th. It's a mix of character homes, newer builds and low-rise condos, and it's a neighbourhood I've helped buyers and sellers in for years. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
point-grey.desc: Point Grey detached and apartment market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.
point-grey.note: Point Grey has too few townhouse sales to chart reliably, so townhouses are not shown.
point-grey.ogdesc: Where Point Grey house and condo values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

dunbar.lede: Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights are two of the Westside's quieter family neighbourhoods, with Pacific Spirit Park on one side and the shops along Dunbar Street close by. This is mostly detached-home territory, so that's what we track here, with MacKenzie Heights shown on its own because it's a small pocket with its own price level. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
dunbar.desc: Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights detached home market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.
dunbar.note: All figures are for detached homes. MacKenzie Heights is a small area with relatively few sales, so its numbers can move more from month to month.
dunbar.ogdesc: Where detached home values in Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

photo.credit: Dunbar · Photo: rowy / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

kerrisdale.lede: Kerrisdale is my home turf. I live here, and my Engel & Völkers office is right in Kerrisdale Village on West 41st. The neighbourhood mixes big detached homes on leafy streets with apartments and townhouses close to the village shops, so we track all three. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.

arbutus.lede: Arbutus sits between Kitsilano and Kerrisdale along the Arbutus Greenway, a quiet stretch of mostly detached homes on generous lots, close to good schools and an easy walk or ride to both villages. GVR tracks detached homes here, so that's what you'll see below. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.

kitsilano.lede: Kitsilano has the beach, West 4th and Broadway, and one of the Westside's most active condo markets. Kits has everything from character conversions and townhouses to detached homes, so we track all three, with condos usually setting the pace. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.

fairview.lede: Fairview climbs from the edge of False Creek up to Broadway, between South Granville and Cambie, a few minutes from downtown and right next to VGH. It's almost all condos and townhouses, which is what we track here. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
fairview.desc: Fairview apartment and townhouse market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.

downtown.lede: The Downtown Peninsula is really four condo markets, each with its own personality. Downtown is the tower core around Granville, Robson and the business district. Yaletown pairs its converted brick warehouses and patios along Mainland and Hamilton with the marina-side neighbourhoods on False Creek, where towers and townhomes sit right on the seawall. Coal Harbour is the quieter waterfront edge, with marina and floatplane views and the highest benchmark price of the four. The West End is the most residential, with leafy blocks, character walk-ups and newer towers between Stanley Park and English Bay. Each moves at its own pace, so we track them side by side. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
downtown.desc: Downtown, Yaletown, Coal Harbour and West End condo market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.
downtown.note: All figures are for apartments (condos), using GVR's Downtown, Yaletown, Coal Harbour and West End areas.
downtown.ogdesc: Where condo values in Downtown, Yaletown, Coal Harbour and the West End are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

photo.credit: Downtown and False Creek · Photo: Adrian Yu / Unsplash

cambie.lede: Cambie is about as central as Vancouver gets. Cambie Village has a good stretch of heritage-listed homes, Queen Elizabeth Park crowns Little Mountain at the city's highest point, and the Canada Line runs right underneath, which is why the corridor keeps filling in with new condos and townhouses. The side streets are still mostly character and newer detached homes, so we track all three. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
cambie.desc: Cambie detached, apartment and townhouse market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
cambie.ogdesc: Where Cambie house, condo and townhouse values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

mount-pleasant.lede: Mount Pleasant is one of Vancouver's oldest neighbourhoods, and you can feel it: heritage houses and older low-rises on the side streets, with a newer wave of condos closer to Main and Broadway. The area grew up around Brewery Creek, and today's craft breweries along Main, plus the murals that go up every summer, keep that spirit going. Condos and townhouses make up most of the sales here, so that's what we track. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
mount-pleasant.desc: Mount Pleasant condo and townhouse market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
mount-pleasant.ogdesc: Where Mount Pleasant condo and townhouse values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.
mount-pleasant.note: Figures are for GVR's Mount Pleasant VE area, which has most of the neighbourhood's sales. GVR's separate Mount Pleasant VW area sees only a couple of sales a month, too few to chart reliably, and detached sales here are too few as well.

main.lede: South of Mount Pleasant, Main Street turns into a long run of independent shops, vintage furniture dealers, cafés and neighbourhood restaurants, with Riley Park close by and Queen Elizabeth Park up on Little Mountain. The side streets are full of character houses, many with suites, and low-rise condos are filling in along the arterials, so we track houses and condos. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
main.desc: Main Street detached and apartment market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
main.ogdesc: Where house and condo values along Main Street are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.
main.note: Townhouse sales in this area are too few to chart reliably, so townhouses are not shown.

fraser.lede: Fraser Street has become a real food destination. Locals call the stretch around Kingsway "Fraserhood," and it's packed with bakeries, cafés and neighbourhood restaurants. Around it is classic family East Van: character and newer houses, many with suites, plus a growing number of low-rise condos, so we track houses and condos. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
fraser.desc: Fraser detached and apartment market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
fraser.ogdesc: Where Fraser house and condo values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.
fraser.note: Townhouse sales in this area are too few to chart reliably, so townhouses are not shown.

grandview.lede: Grandview-Woodland is the multicultural heart of East Van, built around Commercial Drive. The Drive is Vancouver's Little Italy, with a strong Portuguese thread as well, so you get old-school espresso bars, Italian delis, patios and live music, along with a counter-culture streak that's never really left. The side streets mix grand old character homes with older low-rise apartments, so we track houses, condos and townhouses. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
grandview.desc: Grandview-Woodland detached, apartment and townhouse market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
grandview.ogdesc: Where Grandview-Woodland house, condo and townhouse values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

strathcona.lede: Strathcona is Vancouver's oldest residential neighbourhood, a few blocks from Chinatown and Gastown, with colourful restored heritage houses, front porches and community gardens. It's long been a landing place for newcomers and a home for artists, and it's kept its bohemian streak: hundreds of artists open their studios during the Eastside Culture Crawl each November, and you'll meet plenty of film and creative types. It's a small market, so detached homes show in the benchmark price and condos carry the rest. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
strathcona.desc: Strathcona detached and apartment market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
strathcona.ogdesc: Where Strathcona house and condo values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.
strathcona.note: Strathcona sees only about one detached sale a month, so detached homes appear in the benchmark price only; the selling-speed and negotiating charts show condos. Townhouse sales are too few to show.

downtown-eastside.lede: This page tracks GVR's Downtown VE area, the historic east side of downtown that takes in the eastern end of Gastown, Chinatown and the Downtown Eastside. It's home to some of the city's best warehouse loft conversions, with exposed brick, timber beams and tall windows, alongside newer mid-rise condos. Nearly every sale here is a condo, so that's what we track. It's very much a block-by-block market, so treat these numbers as the starting point. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
downtown-eastside.desc: Downtown Eastside condo market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel &amp; Völkers Vancouver.
downtown-eastside.ogdesc: Where Downtown Eastside condo values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.
downtown-eastside.note: All figures are for apartments (condos) in GVR's Downtown VE area.
